say: Every few days, a photo like this lands in the street group chat.
caption: Every few days, a photo like this lands in the street group chat.

say: Tomorrow's power cuts. And everyone does the same sum in their head.
caption: Tomorrow's power cuts. And everyone does the same sum in their head.

say: When is my area off? And what can I still get done?
caption: When is my area off? And what can I still get done?

say: This is On Hours. Take a photo of the notice, and it reads every area, with its power cuts.
caption: This is OnHours. Take a photo of the notice, and it reads every area, with its power cuts.

say: Choose yours. Keep your jobs, or type new ones in plain words. Then plan the day.
caption: Choose yours. Keep your jobs, or type new ones in plain words. Then plan the day.

say: Every job gets one unbroken stretch when the power is on. Nothing starts, and then loses power halfway through.
caption: Every job gets one unbroken stretch when the power is on. Nothing starts, and then loses power halfway through.

say: The AI only reads the notice. Plain, tested code places every job, so the same notice always gives the same plan.
caption: The AI only reads the notice. Plain, tested code places every job, so the same notice always gives the same plan.

say: It copes with a messy picture too. This one is tilted, laid out differently, and writes the times in words. It still reads five areas, and splits the overnight cut at midnight.
caption: It copes with a messy picture too. This one is tilted, laid out differently, and writes the times in words. It still reads five areas, and splits the overnight cut at midnight.

say: When a job can't fit, On Hours says why. These beans need five hours in one go, and the longest stretch left is four hours fifteen.
caption: When a job can't fit, OnHours says why. These beans need five hours in one go, and the longest stretch left is four hours fifteen.

say: If you have an inverter, say how long it runs. Now the beans fit, and the plan tells you when to switch: eight o'clock, for the last forty-five minutes.
caption: If you have an inverter, say how long it runs. Now the beans fit, and the plan tells you when to switch: eight o'clock, for the last forty-five minutes.

say: Backup is just one number: the hours it runs. Nothing to calculate.
caption: Backup is just one number: the hours it runs. Nothing to calculate.

say: Then the chat sends a revised notice. Paste it, and On Hours shows what moved, and why. The iron shifts to four o'clock, and the beans no longer fit.
caption: Then the chat sends a revised notice. Paste it, and OnHours shows what moved, and why. The iron shifts to four o'clock, and the beans no longer fit.

say: And here is the part that matters when the lights go out.
caption: And here is the part that matters when the lights go out.

say: On Hours installs on the phone. Next time you open it, your jobs and your plan are already there.
caption: OnHours installs on the phone. Next time you open it, your jobs and your plan are already there.

say: Switch on airplane mode, and reload. It still tells you the power is off until nine, and what comes next.
caption: Switch on airplane mode, and reload. It still tells you the power is off until nine, and what comes next.

say: Your jobs and your last notice stay on the phone. There is no account, and nothing is tracked.
caption: Your jobs and your last notice stay on the phone. There is no account, and nothing is tracked.

say: Send the plan to the family chat as a picture, or add it to your calendar, with a reminder ten minutes before every cut.
caption: Send the plan to the family chat as a picture, or add it to your calendar, with a reminder ten minutes before every cut.

say: It is for anyone who runs a home, or a small business, around scheduled power cuts. The tailor, the baker, the family with a water pump.
caption: It is for anyone who runs a home, or a small business, around scheduled power cuts. The tailor, the baker, the family with a water pump.

say: Wherever the schedule arrives as a message, On Hours turns it into a day someone can actually follow.
caption: Wherever the schedule arrives as a message, OnHours turns it into a day someone can actually follow.

say: We built it plan first, with the Dev Post skill pack: scope, requirements, spec, then code. It taught us to give the AI one small job, and to keep every decision in code you can test.
caption: We built it plan first, with the Devpost skill pack: scope, requirements, spec, then code. It taught us to give the AI one small job, and to keep every decision in code you can test.
